alt: 窗外暮色漸深，成年工匠仍在檯燈下專心製作木屋模型，桌上堆著完成的零件。
scene_prompt: One adult craftsperson continues carefully constructing a wooden architectural model at a desk late into the night. A large window shows the last faint sunset fading into a deep blue night sky and a crescent moon. A warm desk lamp lights the focused tired face and many completed model pieces; cold tea and accumulated pencil shavings imply long continuous effort. Gentle observational scene, no child working late, no written pages.
